purpose: The hero menu's spell page (docs/hero-screen.md, Spells): spell_book.png, the empty open book the page is laid on; schools.png, a row of five round badges for the schools of magic (basic, beacon, furnace, root, veil). tools/build_hero_menu_icons.py makes art/ui/runtime/hero_menu/spell_book.png and school_*.png from them. spell_page_mockup.png is the layout the owner picked (the grimoire); a reference for scenes/shared/HeroSheet.gd, nothing is cut from it.
note: The PNGs are not tracked (art/*/source/**/*.png is ignored); they are in the source art archive (docs/source-material-storage-map.md) and come back with tools/restore_archived_source_material.py.
